description: Give a company website and get the contact details it publishes: emails, phone numbers and social profile links, read from up to 5 pages of its own site. Use it when: You need the public contact channels of a company from its own website. Not for: Private individuals or personal email discovery; it returns only what the site itself publishes. Returns: Emails, phone numbers and LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and TikTok links, plus the pages it read. Typical time: about 20 s. Price: $0.020 per website, charged only on success. One call = contacts from one website.
name: company-contacts
title: Company contact finder
